name: B6·2 WhatsApp & Instagram at Scale — Flows in-chat forms + IG DM automation + GBP auto-posts (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step (approvals involved)
**A. WhatsApp Flows (in-chat forms — Meta approval):**
1. Meta Business → WhatsApp Manager → Flows → Create: a 'Book Appointment' flow (screens: name, phone, date, occasion). Publish → note FLOW_ID.
2. Create template `book_flow` (category UTILITY) with a Flow button attached (flow_id = FLOW_ID). Wait for approval.
3. When a customer submits the Flow, Meta POSTs to your workflow-2 webhook with `interactive.nfm_reply.response_json` — THIS workflow's `flow-response` path handles it: parses → CRM + calendar-ready alert.

**B. Instagram DM automation at scale (ManyChat Pro):**
1. manychat.com Pro (~$15+/mo) → connect the IG account.
2. Automation → Default Reply / keyword triggers → add an **External Request** action → POST to this workflow's `ig-dm` URL with {name:{{full_name}}, username:{{ig_username}}, message:{{last_input_text}}}.
3. This workflow AI-classifies and returns {reply} — map it back in ManyChat as the response text. You now have unlimited AI-DM handling with n8n logic.

**C. Google Business Profile auto-posts (API allowlist):**
1. Apply: developers.google.com/my-business → request API access for your Google account (takes days).
2. Once approved: create OAuth cred with scope `business.manage`; find LOCATION_ID via accounts.locations.list.
3. The Wednesday timer then auto-posts your ContentBank caption of the week to your Business Profile — the most under-used free local-SEO lever.

## 🔧 FIX
• Flow data empty → check the template's flow button + webhook subscription includes 'messages'.
• ManyChat timeouts → response must return < 10 s; keep Gemini prompt short.
• GBP 403 → API not allowlisted yet, or wrong LOCATION_ID.
